result.edit: The test failure shows incorrect Gray code output at cycle 3 (got 0010, expected 0011). The issue is in the binary-to-Gray conversion where the shift amount was 2 bits instead of 1 bit. Changing the shift from 2 to 1 correctly implements the Gray code conversion formula (binary >> 1) ^ binary, which will produce the expected sequence where only one bit changes between consecutive values.
